name: Meredith
text: It was a young man named Tom..

name: Meredith
text: he warned us about something my memories fail to recall completely..

name: Meredith
text: He told us that… that the signal was more than we could ever understand

name: Meredith
text: That our intellect wasn’t enough neither prepared for it dangerous true force.

name: Meredith
text: He said… he said it was ancient…

name: Meredith
text: something that we should have not tried to comprehend or investigate...

name: Narrator
text: (Her face distorts with fear as her body begins to stiffen, transforming slowly into a statue.)

name: Meredith
text: Find a way to escape and warn them Kyra…

name: Meredith
text: tell them what happened here… tell them about us and about.. you...

name: Meredith
text: before it’s too late for your family to ever see you again.

name: Narrator
text: (Kyra blinks once, Meredith transforms into a statue, leaving Kyra alone. Stunned and horrified, she quickly checks Sam and he also ended up turning into a statue.)
